instruction:
Two-Storey Vertical Duplex Conversion

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required output as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 2 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 8 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, and at least 2 IfcRoof entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: UNIT-A and UNIT-B.
7. UNIT-A is assigned to one storey and UNIT-B is assigned to the other storey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [8.0, 6.0, 6.6].

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
